selection: First development state per zone and UP survival class with at least one safe action; no held-out states
hypothesis: Supplying deterministic candidate forecasts improves Jev safe/progress selection over identical geometry-only questions
primaryMetric: raw chosen action survives ten ticks
secondaryMetric: chosen progressScore equals best safe candidate score
limitations: Small selected development sample; frozen state; predictions and grading share engine; not a full-game or net improvement over local policy claim
estimatedCost: 12 calls at previous roughly 0.0001 cost per request; approximately 0.0012 reported currency units, variable with tokens
